text:
incident-bot: Pager opened — P0 runtime crashloop detected for service=runtime-gpu-ml, region=us-west-2, affected pods=27

incident-bot: Alert details -> CrashLoopBackOff; recent sigsegv in native runtime lib (fused_kernels.so). Pager: @raj (oncall)

raj (oncall): taking it. pinging runtime + infra.

mariam (sre): thx. first question: customer-visible impact?

support (ops): multiple customers seeing 502 / stream disconnects. MapleHealth and Carta reported errors ~03:06 UTC. Error spike from 3% -> 22% error rate on runtime routes.

alyssa (runtime): looking at one pod now. `kubectl logs runtime-gpu-5f8c9 -c runtime --tail=200` shows repeated: `Fatal signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7ffee...` then `Backtrace: fused_kernels.so+0x1d42`

jonathan (prod-eng): can you paste the last few lines?

alyssa (runtime): paste:
```
#0 0x7f9d2e1c1d42 in fused_kernel::execute()+0x7a
#1 0x7f9d2e0f8b2a in runtime::infer_loop()+0x1b4
#2 0x7f9d2e0f2f34 in start_thread+0x1f
```
`dmesg` on host shows: `segfault at 0 ip 00007f9d2e1c1d42 sp 00007ffef3a2d8 error 4 in fused_kernels.so`

raj (oncall): any recent deploys?

alyssa (runtime): yes — runtime image `redwood/runtime:2026-03-16-quant` rolled ~02:50 UTC to subset of nodes (canary->region). Seems crashes correlate with nodes that pulled new image and also have driver 515.x. Older image on other nodes still stable.

mariam (sre): risk: broad rollout might hit more nodes. mitigation options: 1) scale down runtime-gpu node pool on those AZs 2) cordon/evict pods from offending nodes 3) rollback runtime image to previous tag 4) apply temporary affinity to avoid those nodes. Which is fastest?

jonathan (prod-eng): rollback image to previous tag + redeploy is fastest. Also open ticket to pin driver vs runtime ABI.

alyssa (runtime): starting rollback of runtime Deployment to `redwood/runtime:2026-03-09-stable` for runtime-gpu in us-west-2 canary subset. Will push new replicaset.

support (ops): continuing to route traffic to standby region for impacted customers. MapleHealth notified (incident-aware) — they confirmed retrying works for some requests.

incident-bot: Deployment rollback started by alyssa at 03:20 UTC (job id: rb-517765)

raj (oncall): I'll cordon off two affected nodes to stop new pods landing while rollback progresses: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-usw2-14` 

alyssa (runtime): rollback started; new pods coming up. Observed the old image pods start and pass liveness checks.

mariam (sre): telemetry check — error rate dropping from 22% -> 9% after first batch of rollbacks. Keep watching.

alyssa (runtime): collected core dump from one failing pod before it restarted. Uploading to /tmp/incident-517765/core-fused.tar.gz and attaching to the ticket. Stacktrace points at symbol lookup in fused_kernels.so calling into TRT plugin. Could be ABI mismatch with new libc or TensorRT.

jonathan (prod-eng): good capture. We'll need a reproducer and bisect image change. For now, complete rollback across region and disable canary.

support (ops): customers list: MapleHealth (partial outage), Carta (some requester timeouts). SLA alerting triggered — informing CS to prep comms.

raj (oncall): rolling node cordon -> drain for 3 nodes. Will keep two spare to avoid capacity collapse.

alyssa (runtime): rollback finished for 2/3 deployments. Third RS finishing now. Observed pods stable for 10m.

mariam (sre): monitoring shows errors near baseline (~1.2%). Marking incident as partially mitigated. Need postmortem: root cause hypothesis = native kernel/plugin incompatible with updated runtime image and driver combination -> symbol/ABI mismatch causing SIGSEGV in fused kernel.

jonathan (prod-eng): next actions: 1) run extended soak test of new runtime image on staging with driver 515.x, 2) add image-driver compatibility gate to rollout pipeline, 3) keep hotpatch rollback script in runbook.

incident-bot: Pager update: Severity reduced to P1 at 03:45 UTC per @mariam.

support (ops): CS notified customers and posted status page update at 03:48 UTC.

raj (oncall): handing off to morning rotation @mariam for follow-up and postmortem. Leaving notes in incident ticket: rollback tag, core dump path, affected nodes list, telemetry graphs.

mariam (sre): acknowledged. I'll own the postmortem and schedule follow-up with runtime + infra to prevent future ABI drift. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
